We arrived early at 10:30, hoping for prompt care. By 10:50, after waiting patiently, we asked the reception what the delay was, only to be told we weren't even on their list! This was a blatant lie, as we had the confirmation message right on our phone.\n\nSuddenly, a \"miracle\" occurred and our appointment reappeared on their system. Apparently, it had been moved to a later time without a single word of notice to us. We were left waiting with no explanation and no specified time.\n\nWe finally saw the GP at 11:20 for a consultation that took less than 10 minutes. We were told the prescription would be sent straight to the pharmacy next door. We went over immediately, only to begin another ridiculous wait. We stood there for 30 minutes while absolutely nothing happened. We watched as at least two or three other patients, who were behind us in the queue to see the GP, came and went with their prescriptions in hand.\n\nWhere is the logic in that?\n\nAfter 20 minutes of this, I went back to the GP reception to ask what was going on. Their excuse? \"The GP is writing the notes now.\" For 20 minutes? Ten minutes later, my partner went in to ask again and was fed the same pathetic line.\n\nIn total, we wasted 90 minutes of our day being messed around by a completely disorganised and seemingly uncaring system, all while my partner was in significant pain.
